name: WebinarsPage - A Single Recording
description: The empty-to-many boundary, and a reachable one: five of the eleven recordings are already unpublished because their video host lost the uploads. A lone card holds a single column width and lines up with the rows above it, rather than stretching across the whole measure and blowing its cover up into a soft banner - which is what this page did until the grid moved from auto-fit to auto-fill, and what this frame now pins.
